findings: The prior model review over-accepted distractors whose source fact is disputed or time-sensitive.
Six of twenty-two perturbations satisfy the stricter semantic and target-salience criteria.
The cleanest provisional effect remains a single-model Chinese flip and requires the new three-arm rerun.
The two permanent simulation failures belong to a source sample excluded by proxy review, but hy4-preview reliability remains an engineering concern.
next_action: Run the six accepted perturbations under original, neutral, and targeted arms with shared baselines before expanding by approximately twenty paired-control base triples.
